title: One Click, One Space — Create a Space on Any Intelligence

intelligence.essence: Every Smart Note, every intelligence block, carries a "+ CREATE SPACE" button. One click creates a space FROM that intelligence: the note gives the title and the hook, and the space opens a conversation around that topic — a feed to communicate in, invites to bring people in, audio chat, video chat, instant message, mail. The creation is immediate. That is the design, not a defect.
intelligence.human_view: You are reading something that matters to you — a note, an idea, a piece of intelligence. You tap one button. A room opens, named after what you were reading, carrying its hook. People come in. You talk about it — in the feed, by voice, by video, by message, by mail. The intelligence becomes a conversation, and the conversation becomes a community.
intelligence.child_view: You find a cool idea. You press one button. Now you have a clubhouse about that idea, and your friends can come talk about it with you.
intelligence.grandma_view: Every good thought deserves a room where people can gather around it. One tap, and the room exists — named after the thought, ready for talking, for calling, for writing to each other.
intelligence.ai_view: A space is not a page. It is a conversation with a home. The intelligence block is the seed: its title names the space, its hook opens the conversation. The space then carries the full system — feed, invites, audio, video, instant message, mail — because a conversation is not one channel, it is all of them, in one place, around one topic.
intelligence.what_it_means: The "+ CREATE SPACE" button creating a space immediately, with no confirmation dialog, is CORRECT. It is the design Shawn ordered. The inspector flagged instant creation as a defect — that flag is wrong, and it is corrected here.
whats_inside:
1. **Creation stays immediate.** No confirmation dialog. One click, the space exists.
2. **The duplicate is the defect.** A second click on the same note must OPEN the existing space, not create another one. One intelligence, one space. The inspector's two test clicks creating two identically-named spaces is the bug — not the creation, the duplication.
3. **After creation, you land IN the space.** The citizen goes straight into the conversation, with the feed open, the note's title and hook at the top, and invites, audio, video, message, and mail all present. A space that is created but never entered is a room nobody walks into.
4. **Every intelligence block carries it.** Smart Notes, feed cards, any intelligence — the button is the same everywhere, and it always does the same thing: one click, one space, one conversation around that topic.
